_note: insight-exports-and-custom-reports (board SkRapportages): the Custom reports page, reached from its card on the Reports page (no menu entry, ADR-097). A custom page because a report is the caller's OpenRegister export profile over one catalogue schema: listed, defined in a CnFormDialog, run as OpenRegister's download and deleted. OpenRegister owns the profiles, their owner and the export right.

config.description: Your own reports over the catalogue: pick the fields, run them as a file.
